SHESIM VILE 2 KATESHE NE FUSHE -PREZE
Lokacioni prane Aeroportit te Rinasit
Siperfaqe toke 720m2 dhe siperfaqja totale e ndertimit 264m2 ku sejcili kat ka siperfaqe 126m2 dhe pjesa tjeter ballkon.
Kati i pare organizohet nga 2 dhoma gjumi, sallon ndenje bashke me hapesiren e gatimit dhe1 tualet.
Kati i dyte perbehet nga 3 dhoma gjumi, 1 tualet dhe ballkon.
Kati i pare eshte i rregulluar dhe i gatshem per banim, ndersa kati i dyte ofrohet vetem me muret ndarese me mundesi ndryshimi sipas projektit te klientit.
Hapesire e bollshme parkimi .
Zone lehtesisht e aksesueshme, me infrastrukture te rregullt shume prane rruges Vore-Fushe Kruje.
Per nje vizite ne prone ose informacione te tjera me kontaktoni.
title_en: 2-STOREY VILLA FOR SALE IN THE FIELD - PREZE
description_en: 2-STOREY VILLA FOR SALE IN THE FIELD - PREZE Location near Rinas Airport Land area 720m2 and the total construction area 264m2 where each floor has an area of ​​126m2 and the rest has a balcony. The first floor consists of 2 bedrooms, a living room with a kitchen and 1 bathroom. The second floor consists of 3 bedrooms, 1 bathroom and a balcony. The first floor is arranged and ready for living, while the second floor is offered only with partition walls with the possibility of change according to the client's project. Ample parking space. Easily accessible area, with regular infrastructure, very close to Vore-Fushe Kruje road. For a visit to the property or other information, contact me.
